rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site; normative data aggregated from 5 datasets across multiple scanning sites: HCP, OpenBHB (multi-site), OASIS-3, Cam-CAN, NCL, plus 26 BLISS HCs
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "We utilised four public datasets of T1-weighted scans from healthy controls: the WU-Minn Human Connectome Project Young Adult (HCP)... Open Big Healthy Brains (OpenBHB)... Open Access Series of Imaging Studies (OASIS-3)... the Cambridge Centre for Ageing and Neuroscience (Cam-CAN)... We also used a cohort of healthy adult participants scanned at Newcastle University as part of another study (site=NCL)."
rci1_using_msad.location: bdi13484-sup-0001-supinfo.docx.md: Section 1 Normative model of cortical thickness, L7-L14

rci2_using_epd.detail: HCP, OASIS-3, and Cam-CAN are EPDs used for normative model construction; OpenBHB and NCL are not in the EPD list
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "the WU-Minn Human Connectome Project Young Adult (HCP; available at https://www.humanconnectome.org/study/hcp-young-adult)... Open Access Series of Imaging Studies (OASIS-3; available at https://sites.wustl.edu/oasisbrains/home/oasis-3/)... the Cambridge Centre for Ageing and Neuroscience (Cam-CAN; available at http://www.mrc-cbu.cam.ac.uk/datasets/camcan/)"

rci3_epd_name.detail: HCP-YA (n=1113), OASIS-3 (n=542), Cam-CAN (n=644); OpenBHB (n=3984) and NCL (n=61) are not EPDs

rci5_n.detail: Training phase HC after outlier removal; initial sample n=6370 (6344 from 5 datasets per Table S1 + 26 BLISS HC), 393 outliers removed, yielding n=5977
rci5_n.supporting_text: "We utilised public datasets to develop normative models of cortical thickness (n = 5977)" ; "A sample of n = 6344 healthy individuals were included... We harmonised the normative-HC data, including the 26 HCs recruited to BLISS... We removed controls who had outliers in any ROI, defined as residuals greater than 5 median absolute deviations (n = 393)."
rci5_n.location: Little2024.pdf.md: Abstract, L61; Methods / Section 2.4.2, L151

rci6_sex.supporting_text: "normative-HC: mean age 32.64; 50.3% females" ; Table S1 Total: "N=6344, N female=3194, % female=50.3%"
